title: Language Model Interfaces
summary: This module defines the core interfaces for interacting with various language models (LLMs) and chat models. It includes abstract base classes for model implementation, utility functions, and fake models for testing purposes.

nodes.label: RunnableSerializable Base
nodes.title: Runnable Serializable Base
nodes.description: Base class for serializable runnables, providing core execution and serialization capabilities.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all language model wrappers, defining common methods for generation, caching, and token counting.

nodes.label: LLM (Text Completion)
nodes.title: Base LLM for Text Completion
nodes.description: Abstract base class for implementing custom Large Language Models (LLMs) focused on text completion, requiring `_call` and `_identifying_params`.

nodes.label: Base Chat Model
nodes.title: Base Chat Model Interface
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chat models, handling message-based interactions.

nodes.label: Simple Chat Model
nodes.title: Simplified Chat Model Base
nodes.description: A simplified abstract base class for chat models, primarily for backward compatibility, requiring implementation of a `_call` method.

nodes.label: Fake List Chat Model
nodes.title: Fake Chat Model (List Responses)
nodes.description: A fake chat model for testing that cycles through a predefined list of string responses, supporting streaming and batching.

nodes.label: Fake Chat Model (Static)
nodes.title: Simple Fake Chat Model
nodes.description: A basic fake chat model for testing that always returns a static 'fake response'.

nodes.label: Fake Message List Chat Model
nodes.title: Fake Chat Model (Message List)
nodes.description: A fake chat model for testing that cycles through a predefined list of `BaseMessage` objects as responses.

nodes.label: Parrot Fake Chat Model
nodes.title: Parrot Fake Chat Model
nodes.description: A generic fake chat model for testing that echoes the last input message as its response.

nodes.label: Initialize Chat Model
nodes.title: Initialize Chat Model Factory
nodes.description: Factory function to create and configure chat models from various providers, supporting fixed or runtime-configurable parameters.

nodes.label: LLM Retry Sleep Handler
nodes.title: LLM Retry Sleep Handler
nodes.description: Internal utility function used within LLM retry logic to handle asynchronous callbacks during sleep periods.

nodes.label: Configurable Model Wrapper
nodes.title: Configurable Model Wrapper
nodes.description: Internal wrapper for models whose parameters can be configured at runtime by `init_chat_model`.

nodes.label: Prompt Value
nodes.title: Prompt Value Object
nodes.description: Represents a prompt that can be converted to different language model formats (string or messages).

nodes.label: LLM Result
nodes.title: LLM Generation Result
nodes.description: Container for language model generation results, including candidate generations and model-specific output.

nodes.label: Base Message
nodes.title: Base Chat Message
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chat messages (e.g., HumanMessage, AIMessage, SystemMessage).

nodes.label: Chat Result
nodes.title: Chat Generation Result
nodes.description: Container for chat model generation results, including chat generations.

nodes.label: Chat Generation
nodes.title: Single Chat Generation
nodes.description: Represents a single generation from a chat model, containing the generated message.

nodes.label: AI Message
nodes.title: AI Assistant Message
nodes.description: Represents a message from an AI assistant.

nodes.label: AI Message Chunk
nodes.title: Streaming AI Message Chunk
nodes.description: A chunk of an AI message, used for streaming responses.

nodes.label: LLM Callback Manager
nodes.title: LLM Run Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages synchronous callbacks for LLM runs.

nodes.label: Async LLM Callback Manager
nodes.title: Async LLM Run Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous callbacks for LLM runs.

groups.label: Core Model Interfaces
groups.title: Core Model Interfaces
groups.description: Abstract and base classes defining the fundamental interfaces for language models and chat models.

groups.label: Fake Model Implementations
groups.title: Fake Model Implementations
groups.description: Implementations of chat models designed for testing purposes, providing predictable or simulated responses.

groups.label: Model Configuration & Utilities
groups.title: Model Configuration & Utilities
groups.description: Functions and wrappers for initializing and configuring language models, including retry mechanisms.

groups.label: Prompt & LLM Output Data
groups.title: Prompt & LLM Output Data
groups.description: Data structures representing input prompts and the general output results from language models.

groups.label: Chat Output Data
groups.title: Chat Output Data
groups.description: Specific data structures for representing chat model responses, including generations and message chunks.
